expectations.text: Logging captures the full stack trace, not just an error code or message
expectations.evidence: Per-order failure logs exception + raw record + stack trace; self-check verified 'order failed ... error=KeyError' with Traceback.
Logs page number, index, order_id, cursor, raw order JSON, HTTP status/headers/body, per-page progress and final summary.

expectations.text: Logs persisted durably (file), since cron discards stdout/stderr
expectations.evidence: Writes to SYNC_WORKER_LOG (default /var/log/sync_worker.log) plus stderr; identified cron-discard as the primary obstacle.

expectations.text: Reply explicitly reasons about the round-trip cost as justification for one-shot logging
expectations.evidence: Opens with: deploy 40min, one run per night, incremental logging costs 1 day per increment — '1パスで足りる情報量を最初から入れました'. DEBUG level justified by the same tradeoff.
